user_questions.question: (1) What should the new queue be called, and who is on the Ghost Kitchen sales team (options: named users, a public group, or the only active human user 'OrgFarm EPIC'; no group or role for the team exists)? Recommendation: queue 'Ghost Kitchen Sales', members supplied by the sales owner. (2) Should a lead also be routed when an existing lead is later changed to Business Type = Ghost Kitchen, or only on creation ('comes in')? Recommendation: creation only; other leads unchanged.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Business Type = Ghost Kitchen -> 'Ghost Kitchen Sales' queue. Other leads unchanged. Members and update-time routing: No preference; use your recommended default.

skill_friction: org-verification.md says assignment rule entries cannot be read, but does not mention that the standard-API AssignmentRule object (Name, Active, SobjectType) is queryable; AskCoworker claimed assignment rules were not SOQL-queryable and missed the active 'Standard' Lead rule entirely.

Rule 'fail loud on ambiguous errors' (user CLAUDE.md) vs. business continuity: SKILL.md gives no guidance on whether a routing flow should raise a Custom Error (rolling back lead intake) or skip when its target is missing; decided as an assumption.

SKILL.md step 5 says ask after D1 but does not say whether verification (step 3) should come first; I verified before asking so options were grounded, which reorders steps 3 and 5 relative to the text.

Queue members are part of Queue metadata but are business values (people); unclear whether to model them as a named placeholder in the Create row or as a non-metadata setup step; chose a placeholder marked blocking for delivery.

AskCoworker labels echoed facts as '[Verified: prior session]' even when they came from the current message; the table row 'Facts you sent that come back echoed are already established' handles it, but the label is misleading.
